title: AI Is Designing Chips by Itself! 🔧
body: AI Is Designing Chips by Itself! 🔧

OpenAI said its models rewrote parts of the design of AMD's flagship chip, achieving improvements of up to 14% in power, performance and area — and AMD adopted some of these changes in a design that has actually been sent for manufacturing.
AI is no longer just writing text — it is building the hardware it runs on.
Are we entering an era where machines design themselves? 🤖
